name: Ruohan Zhang
title: Assistant Professor
department: Computer Science; Center for Robotics and Biosystems
fitReason: Dream2Flow (ICRA 2026) translates generated human-object interaction videos into robot control using 3D object flow. IMPASTO (2026) learns painting dynamics from robot self-play and plans force-sensitive brushstrokes.

physicalEvidence.summary: Dream2Flow executes planned motions on a physical Franka for household tasks such as opening a drawer and sweeping pasta. IMPASTO uses a Franka Panda with a six-axis force/torque sensor and real brush/paint, with learned pixel dynamics and closed-loop planning.

shortVisit.summary: The faculty’s published Northwestern recruitment announcement explicitly invites research interns through a form, separately from PhD applications. It does not state duration, funding, external-master’s restrictions or summer 2027 availability.

scoreReasons.fit: Exceptionally direct foundation-model, world-model and physical manipulation agenda.
scoreReasons.physical: Verified Franka experiments were conducted during the preceding Stanford affiliation; current Northwestern hardware availability is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit research-intern inquiry route, duration and applicant eligibility unspecified.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current Fall 2026 Northwestern directory and 2026 physical learning projects.

name: Yen-Ling Kuo
title: Assistant Professor; Anita Jones Faculty Fellow
fitReason: TF-Gripper/RETAF (February 2026) learns fast tactile force adaptation separately from slower end-effector pose policies, including Diffusion Policy and pi0.5. This directly connects multimodal learning with contact-sensitive physical manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: The primary study names a Franka Research 3 with the custom TF-Gripper and two RealSense cameras. Five physical tasks include tofu, potato-chip and tomato handling and dropper-based liquid transfer. Hardware is evaluated with learned policies rather than only teleoperation.

shortVisit.summary: An official NTU partner listing explicitly describes Kuo’s summer research internships for master’s as well as other degree levels, normally twelve weeks. This is useful evidence of an external-student route in that partner context, but eligibility for a external-university applicant through or outside that program is unverified. Her current personal page only generally invites motivated students.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct multimodal learning and tactile manipulation with foundation-policy integration.
scoreReasons.physical: Named real arm/gripper and five policy-controlled manipulation tasks.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Partner-program route documented, but external-university applicant eligibility and eight-week route unknown; no credit assumed.
scoreReasons.freshness: February 2026 hardware-learning study and current official faculty record.

name: Anand Bhattad
title: Assistant Professor
department: Computer Science; Data Science and AI Institute
fitReason: Know Your Camera (ICRA 2026) improves policy generalization by explicitly conditioning ACT, Diffusion Policy and SmolVLA on camera geometry. The broader 3P group studies physical reasoning and perceptual structure in generative models.

physicalEvidence.summary: The primary paper’s real experiment uses a UR5 with Robotiq three-finger gripper on pick-and-place, plate insertion and mug hanging. ACT and Diffusion Policy are trained and executed under varied camera poses. SmolVLA’s reported evaluations are simulated, not this physical experiment.

shortVisit.summary: The rendered faculty page lists BS/MS researchers and external student collaborators, but no current external short-term internship or visiting-master’s invitation was found. These memberships are precedent only.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong perception-policy generalization fit; broader group primarily vision/generative modeling.
scoreReasons.physical: The physical camera-conditioned policy study is a TTIC/TRI collaboration; current JHU-local hardware is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current external short-term invitation verified; collaborators are precedent.
scoreReasons.freshness: ICRA 2026 project and September 2026 current lab updates.
